name: DBS Altitude Visa Signature Card

mpd:travel.note: Up to | S$1 = 10 miles on hotel transactions on Kaligo; 6 miles per dollar on hotel bookings on Expedia.

percent:local.note: (Non-direct Cashback) S$1 local spend = 1.3 miles on all local spend (0.6 DBS Points). $10 cash credit = 1,200 DBS Points. Equivalent to 0.5% cashback.

percent:overseas.note: (Non-direct Cashback) S$1 local spend = 2.2 miles on all local spend (1 DBS Point). $10 cash credit = 1,200 DBS Points. Equivalent to 0.83% cashback.

percent:baseline.note: (Non-direct Cashback) S$1 local spend = 1.3 miles on all local spend (0.6 DBS Points). $10 cash credit = 1,200 DBS Points. Equivalent to 0.5% cashback.

mpd:overseas.note: Up to  | On overseas spend made in foreign currency.

highlights: Up to 2.2 mpd for overseas FCY spend and 1.3 mpd on other local spend.
pros: Up to 1.3 miles per S$1 spent locally, including bus and train rides.
pros: Up to 2.2 miles per S$1 spent on overseas purchases in foreign currency.
pros: Receive 10,000 bonus miles when you pay the annual fee of S$196.20
pros: 2 free lounge visits within each 12-month period of your membership to over 1,500 airport lounges worldwide.
pros: Read our full review of the DBS Altitude Card.
cons: Miles are awarded in the form of DBS points which are awarded for every S$5 spent.
cons: Each conversion of DBS points to miles will be subjected to an administrative fee of S$25 (exclusive of GST).

Stackable Welcome Offer promotion is valid from 1 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new DBS / POSB credit cardmembers only.

Receive an additional S$100 cash with a minimum S$188 closing balance accumulated for Cashline withdrawals in the first two statement months upon account opening.

 apply.
